# Patterns that must never appear in this public repository.
#
# Deliberately written to match by SHAPE rather than by listing internal names:
# a pattern file that enumerates what it is hiding is itself a disclosure, and
# it hands a reader the exact vocabulary to search for. Each line below catches
# a whole family, so it also catches names that did not exist when it was
# written.

# Source paths from the private repository this code was extracted from.
src/(yotta|common)[a-z-]*/

# Internal repository names: the product word followed by a hyphen and a
# suffix. yottabot and yotta.bot are legitimate and do not match.
\byotta-[a-z]+\b

# References to internal planning documents.
[Pp]lan #[0-9]
docs/plans/

# Internal build tags and agent instruction files.
prod-[0-9a-f]{7}
CLAUDE\.md

# Cloud account identifiers, registry hosts, and resource identifiers. The
# backing cloud for a customer's deployment is an implementation detail and
# must not surface in customer-facing material.
#
# The account id is scoped to the contexts it actually appears in. A bare
# twelve-digit pattern also matches digit runs inside pinned action SHAs and Go
# pseudo-version timestamps, which made the scan fire on every workflow file.
[0-9]{12}\.dkr\.ecr
arn:[a-z-]+:[a-z0-9-]*:[a-z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}
\.dkr\.ecr\.
amazonaws\.com
